description: This file contains integration tests for the /tasks API endpoints of a FastAPI application, using an in-memory SQLite database. It covers various scenarios including authentication enforcement, task creation, retrieval, updating, toggling completion status, and deletion, with focus on user ownership and validation.

methods.name: test_auth_required_on_all_routes(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that all /tasks endpoints require authentication, expecting 401 Unauthorized without token.

methods.name: test_create_task_and_get_list_pagination(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Creates tasks and tests pagination and listing for a specific user.

methods.name: test_get_task_and_ownership_enforced(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Verifies that only the owner can access their task and that 404 is returned for other users or missing tasks.

methods.name: test_put_update_task_and_validation(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Tests full task update, validation errors for empty titles, cross-user access, and not found cases.

methods.name: test_toggle_task_completion(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Tests toggling the completion status of a task, both implicit flip and explicit setting, including access control.

methods.name: test_delete_task_only_owner(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Ensures only the owner can delete a task, and proper response for subsequent deletion attempts.
